blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Thursday said United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres and leaders from the Association of Southeast Asian Nations Plus Three and East Asia Summit (EAS) are expected to attend the 49th Asean Summit in November. On Tuesday, Palace press officer Claire Castro confirmed that U.S. President Donald Trump would attend the high-level gathering. READ: Trump in PH next month for Asean summit – Palace “We expect the Asean leaders to attend the summit. As for dialogue partners, we expect the leaders from Asean Plus Three and the EAS or East Asia Summit to attend, although, at the moment, […]...
